dropped entries are compacted lazily.\n//\n// If \"out\" is given, the members are written in insertion order.\n// If \"bestKey\" is given, the construction stops as soon as the cluster provably\n// cannot beat *bestKey; the result is then -(upper bound on the cardinality).\n// Otherwise the exact cardinality is returned.\n__device__ int greedyCluster(const int seed, const int* __restrict__ nb, int K,\n                             const double2* __restrict__ pts, const DistParams dp,\n                             Scratch s, int* __restrict__ out,\n                             const unsigned long long* bestKey) {\n    const int lane = threadIdx.x & (WARP - 1);\n    const unsigned ltMask = (1u << lane) - 1u;\n    const double2 sp = pts[seed];\n    const float SLACK = 1.0f + 0x1p-20f;\n\n    double bmd = HUGE_VAL;\n    int bid = NO_POINT;\n    float bmf = HUGE_VALF;\n    int w = 0;\n    for (int base = 0; base < K; base += WARP) {\n        const int j = base + lane;\n        bool keep = false;\n        double md = 0.0;\n        double2 p = make_double2(0.0, 0.0);\n        int id = 0;\n        if (j < K) {\n            id = nb[j];\n            p = pts[id];\n            md = pointDistance2(p.x, p.y, sp.x, sp.y);\n            keep = lessThr(md, dp.thr2);\n        }\n        const unsigned m = __ballot_sync(0xffffffffu, keep);\n        if (keep) {\n            const int pos = w + __popc(m & ltMask);\n            const float mf = toFloat(md);\n            s.xf[pos] = (float)(p.x - sp.x); s.yf[pos] = (float)(p.y - sp.y);\n            s.mdf[pos] = mf; s.md[pos] = md; s.id[pos] = id;\n            if (better(md, id, bmd, bid)) { bmd = md; bid = id; bmf = mf; }\n        }\n        w += __popc(m);\n    }\n    K = w;\n\n    int size = 1;\n    if (out && lane == 0) out[0] = seed;\n    int dead = 0;\n\n    while (true) {\n        warpArgMin(bmd, bid);\n        if (bid == NO_POINT) break;\n        const int newId = bid;\n        if (out && lane == 0) out[size] = newId;\n        ++size;\n        const double2 np = pts[newId];\n        const float nxf = (float)(np.x - sp.x);\n        const float nyf = (float)(np.y - sp.y);\n\n        unsigned long long curBest = 0ull;\n        if (bestKey && lane == 0) curBest = *((volatile const unsigned long long*)bestKey);\n\n        bmd = HUGE_VAL;\n        bid = NO_POINT;\n        bmf = HUGE_VALF;\n        const bool compact = dead * 4 > K;\n        w = 0;\n        int died = 0;\n        for (int base = 0; base < K; base += WARP) {\n            const int j = base + lane;\n            bool alive = false, changed = false;\n            float f = HUGE_VALF;\n            int id = 0;\n            if (j < K) {\n                f = s.mdf[j];\n                id = s.id[j];\n                alive = f < HUGE_VALF && id != newId;\n                changed = f < HUGE_VALF && !alive;\n            }\n            float xf = 0.0f, yf = 0.0f;\n            double md = 0.0;\n            bool mdLoaded = false;\n            if (alive) {\n                xf = s.xf[j]; yf = s.yf[j];\n                const float dxf = xf - nxf, dyf = yf - nyf;\n                const float d2f = fmaf(dxf, dxf, dyf * dyf);\n                if (d2f + dp.eps < f) {\n                    // max distance certainly unchanged\n                } else if (d2f - dp.eps > dp.thr2f) {\n                    alive = false;  // certainly beyond the threshold\n                    changed = true;\n                } else {\n                    const double2 p = pts[id];\n                    const double d2 = pointDistance2(p.x, p.y, np.x, np.y);\n                    md = s.md[j];\n                    mdLoaded = true;\n                    if (__double_as_longlong(d2) > __double_as_longlong(md)) {\n                        md = d2;\n                        changed = true;\n                        if (lessThr(md, dp.thr2)) f = toFloat(md);\n                        else alive = false;\n                    }\n                }\n            }\n            if (compact) {\n                const unsigned m = __ballot_sync(0xffffffffu, alive);\n                if (alive) {\n                    if (!mdLoaded) md = s.md[j];\n                    mdLoaded = true;\n                    const int pos = w + __popc(m & ltMask);\n                    s.xf[pos] = xf; s.yf[pos] = yf; s.mdf[pos] = f; s.md[pos] = md; s.id[pos] = id;\n                }\n                w += __popc(m);\n            } else if (changed) {\n                if (alive) { s.mdf[j] = f; s.md[j] = md; }\n                else { s.mdf[j] = HUGE_VALF; ++died; }\n            }\n            if (alive && f <= bmf * SLACK) {\n                if (!mdLoaded) md = s.md[j];\n                if (better(md, id, bmd, bid)) { bmd = md; bid = id; bmf = f; }\n            }\n        }\n        int alive;\n        if (compact) {\n            K = w;\n            dead = 0;\n            alive = K;\n        } else {\n            #pragma unroll\n            for (int off = WARP / 2; off > 0; off >>= 1) died += __shfl_xor_sync(0xffffffffu, died, off);\n            dead += died;\n            alive = K - dead;\n        }\n        if (bestKey) {\n            // Upper bound: every live candidate joins the cluster\n            curBest = __shfl_sync(0xffffffffu, curBest, 0);\n            if (packKey(size + alive, seed) <= curBest) return -(size + alive);\n        }\n    }\n    return size;\n}\n\n// Count neighbours (dist < threshold, excluding self) of each local seed\n__global__ void countNeighborsKernel(const double2* __restrict__ pts,\n                                     const float2* __restrict__ ptsf, const int N,\n                                     const int* __restrict__ seeds, const int M,\n                                     const double thr2, const float boxf, int* __restrict__ cnt) {\n    const int lane = threadIdx.x & (WARP - 1);\n    const int warpGlobal = (blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x) / WARP;\n    const int numWarps = (gridDim.x * blockDim.x) / WARP;\n    for (int i = warpGlobal; i < M; i += numWarps) {\n        const int s = seeds[i];\n        const double2 sp = pts[s];\n        const float2 spf = ptsf[s];\n        int c = 0;\n        for (int base = 0; base < N; base += WARP) {\n            const int j = base + lane;\n            bool keep = false;\n            if (j < N && j != s) {\n                // single precision bounding box rejection (conservative margin)\n                const float2 pf = ptsf[j];\n                if (fabsf(pf.x - spf.x) <= boxf && fabsf(pf.y - spf.y) <= boxf) {\n                    const double2 p = pts[j];\n                    keep = lessThr(pointDistance2(p.x, p.y, sp.x, sp.y), thr2);\n                }\n            }\n            c += __popc(__ballot_sync(0xffffffffu, keep));\n        }\n        if (lane == 0) cnt[i] = c;\n    }\n}\n\n// Fill neighbour lists (sorted by point index) of each local seed\n__global__ void fillNeighborsKernel(const double2* __restrict__ pts,\n                                    const float2* __restrict__ ptsf, const int N,\n                                    const int* __restrict__ seeds, const int M,\n                                    const double thr2, const float boxf,\n                                    const long long* __restrict__ off, int* __restrict__ nbr) {\n    const int lane = threadIdx.x & (WARP - 1);\n    const unsigned ltMask = (1u << lane) - 1u;\n    const int warpGlobal = (blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x) / WARP;\n    const int numWarps = (gridDim.x * blockDim.x) / WARP;\n    for (int i = warpGlobal; i < M; i += numWarps) {\n        const int s = seeds[i];\n        const double2 sp = pts[s];\n        const float2 spf = ptsf[s];\n        int* list = nbr + off[i];\n        int w = 0;\n        for (int base = 0; base < N; base += WARP) {\n            const int j = base + lane;\n            bool keep = false;\n            if (j < N && j != s) {\n                const float2 pf = ptsf[j];\n                if (fabsf(pf.x - spf.x) <= boxf && fabsf(pf.y - spf.y) <= boxf) {\n                    const double2 p = pts[j];\n                    keep = lessThr(pointDistance2(p.x, p.y, sp.x, sp.y), thr2);\n                }\n            }\n            const unsigned m = __ballot_sync(0xffffffffu, keep);\n            if (keep) list[w + __popc(m & ltMask)] = j;\n            w += __popc(m);\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// Start of a QT round on the local seeds: seeds near the last selected cluster\n// drop their newly clustered neighbours; if the neighbourhood changed (or on the\n// first round) the cached cardinality is replaced by the upper bound 1 + #neighbours.\n// Seeds with an exact cardinality contribute to exactBest, the others are queued.\n__global__ void roundPrepareKernel(const float2* __restrict__ ptsf,\n                                   const unsigned char* __restrict__ clustered,\n                                   const int* __restrict__ seeds, const int M,\n                                   const long long* __restrict__ off,\n                                   int* __restrict__ nbrCnt, int* __restrict__ nbr,\n                                   int* __restrict__ card, unsigned char* __restrict__ exact,\n                                   const int firstRound, const float2 lastSeed, const float box2,\n                                   unsigned long long* __restrict__ pendKeys,\n                                   int* __restrict__ pendIdx, WorkState* ws) {\n    const int lane = threadIdx.x & (WARP - 1);\n    const unsigned ltMask = (1u << lane) - 1u;\n    const int warpGlobal = (blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x) / WARP;\n    const int numWarps = (gridDim.x * blockDim.x) / WARP;\n    unsigned long long localExact = 0ull;\n    for (int i0 = warpGlobal * WARP; i0 < M; i0 += numWarps * WARP) {\n        // one seed per lane for the cheap checks\n        const int iMine = i0 + lane;\n        int seedMine = 0;\n        bool active = false, touched = false;\n        if (iMine < M) {\n            seedMine = seeds[iMine];\n            active = !clustered[seedMine];\n            if (active) {\n                // Members of the last cluster lie within threshold of its seed, so\n                // only seeds within 2 * threshold (box test, with margin) can change.\n                const float2 pf = ptsf[seedMine];\n                touched = firstRound ||\n                          (fabsf(pf.x - lastSeed.x) <= box2 && fabsf(pf.y - lastSeed.y) <= box2);\n            }\n        }\n        // compact the neighbour lists of touched seeds, one warp-wide pass per seed\n        unsigned todo = __ballot_sync(0xffffffffu, touched);\n        while (todo) {\n            const int src = __ffs(todo) - 1;\n            todo &= todo - 1;\n            const int i = i0 + src;\n            int* list = nbr + off[i];\n            const int K = nbrCnt[i];\n            int w = 0;\n            for (int base = 0; base < K; base += WARP) {\n                const int j = base + lane;\n                bool keep = false;\n                int id = 0;\n                if (j < K) {\n                    id = list[j];\n                    keep = !clustered[id];\n                }\n                const unsigned m = __ballot_sync(0xffffffffu, keep);\n                if (keep) list[w + __popc(m & ltMask)] = id;\n                w += __popc(m);\n            }\n            if (lane == 0 && (firstRound || w != K)) {\n                nbrCnt[i] = w;\n                card[i] = 1 + w;\n                exact[i] = 0;\n            }\n        }\n        __syncwarp();\n        if (active) {\n            const unsigned long long key = packKey(card[iMine], seedMine);\n            if (exact[iMine]) {\n                localExact = key > localExact ? key : localExact;\n            } else {\n                const int slot = atomicAdd(&ws->pending, 1);\n                pendKeys[slot] = key;\n                pendIdx[slot] = iMine;\n            }\n        }\n    }\n    #pragma unroll\n    for (int o = WARP / 2; o > 0; o >>= 1) {\n        const unsigned long long other = __shfl_xor_sync(0xffffffffu, localExact, o);\n        localExact = other > localExact ? other : localExact;\n    }\n    if (lane == 0 && localExact) atomicMax(&ws->exactBest, localExact);\n}\n\n// Evaluate queued seeds in descending order of their upper bound. A seed is only\n// processed while its bound can still beat the best key; its construction stops\n// early once it cannot. Exact results update the cache and the best key.\n__global__ void roundEvaluateKernel(const double2* __restrict__ pts,\n                                    const int* __restrict__ seeds,\n                                    const long long* __restrict__ off,\n                                    const int* __restrict__ nbrCnt, const int* __restrict__ nbr,\n                                    int* __restrict__ card, unsigned char* __restrict__ exact,\n                                    const unsigned long long* __restrict__ pendKeys,\n                                    const int* __restrict__ pendIdx, const int count,\n                                    const DistParams dp, Scratch scratch,\n                                    const long long scratchStride, WorkState* ws) {\n    const int lane = threadIdx.x & (WARP - 1);\n    const long long warpGlobal = (blockIdx.x * (long long)blockDim.x + threadIdx.x) / WARP;\n    Scratch s;\n    s.xf = scratch.xf + warpGlobal * scratchStride;\n    s.yf = scratch.yf + warpGlobal * scratchStride;\n    s.mdf = scratch.mdf + warpGlobal * scratchStride;\n    s.md = scratch.md + warpGlobal * scratchStride;\n    s.id = scratch.id + warpGlobal * scratchStride;\n\n    while (true) {\n        int t = 0;\n        unsigned long long cur = 0ull;\n        if (lane == 0) {\n            t = atomicAdd(&ws->counter, 1);\n            cur = *((volatile unsigned long long*)&ws->best);\n        }\n        t = __shfl_sync(0xffffffffu, t, 0);\n        cur = __shfl_sync(0xffffffffu, cur, 0);\n        if (t >= count) break;\n        if (pendKeys[t] <= cur) break;  // sorted: no later seed can win either\n        const int i = pendIdx[t];\n        const int seed = seeds[i];\n        const int c = greedyCluster(seed, nbr + off[i], nbrCnt[i], pts, dp, s, nullptr, &ws->best);\n        if (lane == 0) {\n            if (c > 0) {\n                card[i] = c;\n                exact[i] = 1;\n                atomicMax(&ws->best, packKey(c, seed));\n            } else {\n                card[i] = -c;\n            }\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// Produce the member list (in insertion order) of the candidate cluster of local seed i\n__global__ void clusterMembersKernel(const double2* __restrict__ pts, const int* __restrict__ seeds,\n                                     const int i, const long long* __restrict__ off,\n                                     const int* __restrict__ nbrCnt, const int* __restrict__ nbr,\n                                     const DistParams dp, Scratch s, int* __restrict__ out,\n                                     int* __restrict__ outSize) {\n    const int size = greedyCluster(seeds[i], nbr + off[i], nbrCnt[i], pts, dp, s, out, nullptr);\n    if (threadIdx.x == 0) *outSize = size;\n}\n\n__global__ void markClusteredKernel(const int* __restrict__ members, const int n,\n                                    unsigned char* __restrict__ clustered) {\n    const int t = blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;\n    if (t < n) clustered[members[t]] = 1;\n}\n\n// Main QT clustering algorithm (distributed over MPI ranks, one GPU per rank).\n// Every rank returns the full, identical cluster list.\nstd::vector<Cluster> qtClustering(const std::vector<Point>& points,\n                                  const double threshold) {\n    int rank = 0, nranks = 1;\n    MPI_Comm_rank(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &rank);\n    MPI_Comm_size(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &nranks);\n\n    const int N = static_cast<int>(points.size());\n    std::vector<Cluster> clusters;\n    if (N == 0) return clusters;\n\n    // Smallest squared distance whose square root reaches the threshold\n    double thr2 = threshold * threshold;\n    while (thr2 > 0.0 && std::sqrt(thr2) >= threshold) thr2 = std::nextafter(thr2, 0.0);\n    while (std::sqrt(thr2) < threshold) thr2 = std::nextafter(thr2, HUGE_VAL);\n\n    // Single precision filter parameters. Candidate coordinates are taken relative\n    // to the seed (|.| < threshold), which bounds the float error of squared\n    // distances by ~thr2 * 2^-17; eps = thr2 * 2^-12 leaves a wide safety margin.\n    // Filtering is disabled (eps = inf) outside a safe float range.\n    DistParams dp;\n    dp.thr2 = thr2;\n    const bool floatOk = thr2 > 1e-20 && thr2 < 1e20;\n    dp.thr2f = floatOk ? static_cast<float>(thr2) : HUGE_VALF;\n    dp.eps = floatOk ? static_cast<float>(thr2 * 0x1p-12) : HUGE_VALF;\n\n    // Bounding box margins for single precision coordinate tests:\n    // conversion errors are bounded by maxCoord * 2^-24 per coordinate.\n    double maxCoord = 0.0;\n    #pragma omp parallel for reduction(max:maxCoord) if(N > 65536)\n    for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {\n        maxCoord = std::max(maxCoord, std::max(std::fabs(points[i].x), std::fabs(points[i].y)));\n    }\n    const double box = threshold * (1.0 + 0x1p-16) + maxCoord * 0x1p-16;\n    const bool boxOk = box < 1e30 && std::isfinite(maxCoord);\n    const float boxf = boxOk ? static_cast<float>(box) : HUGE_VALF;\n    const float box2f = boxOk ? static_cast<float>(2.0 * box) : HUGE_VALF;\n    std::vector<float2> pointsf(N);\n    #pragma omp parallel for if(N > 65536)\n    for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {\n        pointsf[i] = make_float2(static_cast<float>(points[i].x), static_cast<float>(points[i].y));\n    }\n\n    // Seeds are distributed cyclically over ranks (generated groups are contiguous)\n    std::vector<int> seeds;\n    for (int i = rank; i < N; i += nranks) seeds.push_back(i);\n    const int M = static_cast<int>(seeds.size());\n    const int Mm = std::max(M, 1);\n\n    int device = 0, numSMs = 1, maxThreadsPerSM = 2048;\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetDevice(&device));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaDeviceGetAttribute(&numSMs, cudaDevAttrMultiProcessorCount, device));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaDeviceGetAttribute(&maxThreadsPerSM, cudaDevAttrMaxThreadsPerMultiProcessor, device));\n    const int fullGridWarps = numSMs * (maxThreadsPerSM / WARP);\n\n    static_assert(sizeof(Point) == sizeof(double2), \"Point layout\");\n    double2* d_pts = nullptr;\n    float2* d_ptsf = nullptr;\n    unsigned char* d_clustered = nullptr;\n    int* d_seeds = nullptr;\n    int* d_cnt = nullptr;\n    int* d_card = nullptr;\n    unsigned char* d_exact = nullptr;\n    long long* d_off = nullptr;\n    int* d_nbr = nullptr;\n    int* d_members = nullptr;\n    int* d_size = nullptr;\n    WorkState* d_ws = nullptr;\n    unsigned long long* d_pendKeys[2] = {nullptr, nullptr};\n    int* d_pendIdx[2] = {nullptr, nullptr};\n\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&d_pts, sizeof(double2) * N));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(d_pts, points.data(), sizeof(double2) * N, cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&d_ptsf, sizeof(float2) * N));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(d_ptsf, pointsf.data(), sizeof(float2) * N, cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&d_clustered, N));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemset(d_clustered, 0, N));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&d_members, sizeof(int) * N));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&d_size, sizeof(int)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&d_ws, sizeof(WorkState)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&d_seeds, sizeof(int) * Mm));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&d_cnt, sizeof(int) * Mm));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&d_card, sizeof(int) * Mm));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&d_exact, Mm));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemset(d_exact, 0, Mm));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&d_off, sizeof(long long) * (Mm + 1)));\n    for (int b = 0; b < 2; ++b) {\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&d_pendKeys[b], sizeof(unsigned long long) * Mm));\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&d_pendIdx[b], sizeof(int) * Mm));\n    }\n\n    // Build the neighbour lists of the local seeds\n    std::vector<int> cnt(M, 0);\n    std::vector<long long> off(M + 1, 0);\n    int maxK = 1;\n    const int seedBlocks = std::max(1, std::min((M + WARPS_PER_BLOCK - 1) / WARPS_PER_BLOCK,\n                                                fullGridWarps / WARPS_PER_BLOCK));\n    if (M > 0) {\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(d_seeds, seeds.data(), sizeof(int) * M, cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n        countNeighborsKernel<<<seedBlocks, BLOCK>>>(d_pts, d_ptsf, N, d_seeds, M, thr2, boxf, d_cnt);\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(cnt.data(), d_cnt, sizeof(int) * M, cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));\n        for (int i = 0; i < M; ++i) {\n            off[i + 1] = off[i] + cnt[i];\n            maxK = std::max(maxK, cnt[i]);\n        }\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(d_off, off.data(), sizeof(long long) * (M + 1), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n    }\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&d_nbr, sizeof(int) * std::max<long long>(off[M], 1)));\n    if (M > 0) {\n        fillNeighborsKernel<<<seedBlocks, BLOCK>>>(d_pts, d_ptsf, N, d_seeds, M, thr2, boxf, d_off, d_nbr);\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());\n    }\n\n    // Per-warp scratch space for the evaluation kernel, bounded by a memory budget\n    const size_t entryBytes = 3 * sizeof(float) + sizeof(double) + sizeof(int);\n    size_t freeMem = 0, totalMem = 0;\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemGetInfo(&freeMem, &totalMem));\n    const long long warpsByMem =\n        static_cast<long long>((freeMem / 2) / (entryBytes * static_cast<size_t>(maxK)));\n    long long evalWarps = std::min<long long>(fullGridWarps, Mm);\n    evalWarps = std::min(evalWarps, std::max<long long>(warpsByMem / WARPS_PER_BLOCK * WARPS_PER_BLOCK,\n                                                        WARPS_PER_BLOCK));\n    const int evalBlocks = static_cast<int>((evalWarps + WARPS_PER_BLOCK - 1) / WARPS_PER_BLOCK);\n    const long long slots = static_cast<long long>(evalBlocks) * WARPS_PER_BLOCK;\n    const long long stride = maxK;\n    Scratch scratch;\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&scratch.xf, sizeof(float) * slots * stride));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&scratch.yf, sizeof(float) * slots * stride));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&scratch.mdf, sizeof(float) * slots * stride));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&scratch.md, sizeof(double) * slots * stride));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&scratch.id, sizeof(int) * slots * stride));\n\n    // Temporary storage for sorting the queued seeds by bound (descending)\n    void* d_sortTemp = nullptr;\n    size_t sortTempBytes = 0;\n    CUDA_CHECK(cub::DeviceRadixSort::SortPairsDescending(\n        nullptr, sortTempBytes, d_pendKeys[0], d_pendKeys[1], d_pendIdx[0], d_pendIdx[1], Mm));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&d_sortTemp, std::max<size_t>(sortTempBytes, 1)));\n\n    const int prepBlocks = std::max(1, std::min((M + BLOCK - 1) / BLOCK, fullGridWarps / WARPS_PER_BLOCK));\n\n    std::vector<unsigned char> clustered(N, 0);\n    std::vector<int> members(N);\n    bool firstRound = true;\n    float2 lastSeed = make_float2(0.0f, 0.0f);\n    WorkState hws;\n\n    while (true) {\n        // Phase 1: refresh changed neighbourhoods, collect exact cached cardinalities\n        unsigned long long localExact = 0ull;\n        int pending = 0;\n        if (M > 0) {\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemsetAsync(d_ws, 0, sizeof(WorkState)));\n            roundPrepareKernel<<<prepBlocks, BLOCK>>>(d_ptsf, d_clustered, d_seeds, M, d_off, d_cnt,\n                                                     d_nbr, d_card, d_exact, firstRound ? 1 : 0,\n                                                     lastSeed, box2f, d_pendKeys[0], d_pendIdx[0], d_ws);\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(&hws, d_ws, sizeof(WorkState), cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));\n            localExact = hws.exactBest;\n            pending = hws.pending;\n        }\n        firstRound = false;\n        unsigned long long globalExact = 0ull;\n        MPI_Allreduce(&localExact, &globalExact, 1, MPI_UNSIGNED_LONG_LONG, MPI_MAX, MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n\n        // Phase 2: evaluate queued seeds that may still beat the best key\n        unsigned long long localBest = globalExact;\n        if (pending > 0) {\n            CUDA_CHECK(cub::DeviceRadixSort::SortPairsDescending(\n                d_sortTemp, sortTempBytes, d_pendKeys[0], d_pendKeys[1], d_pendIdx[0], d_pendIdx[1],\n                pending));\n            hws.best = globalExact;\n            hws.exactBest = 0ull;\n            hws.counter = 0;\n            hws.pending = pending;\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(d_ws, &hws, sizeof(WorkState), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n            const int blocks = std::max(1, std::min<int>(evalBlocks, (pending + WARPS_PER_BLOCK - 1) / WARPS_PER_BLOCK));\n            roundEvaluateKernel<<<blocks, base < N; base += WARP) {\n            const int j = base + lane;\n            bool keep = false;\n            if (j < N && j != s) {\n                const float2 pf = ptsf[j];\n                if (fabsf(pf.x - spf.x) <= boxf && fabsf(pf.y - spf.y) <= boxf) {\n                    const double2 p = pts[j];\n                    keep = lessThr(pointDistance2(p.x, p.y, sp.x, sp.y), thr2);\n                }\n            }\n            const unsigned m = __ballot_sync(0xffffffffu, keep);\n            if (keep) list[w + __popc(m & ltMask)] = j;\n            w += __popc(m);\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// Start of a QT round on the local seeds: seeds near the last selected cluster\n// drop their newly clustered neighbours; if the neighbourhood changed (or on the\n// first round) the cached cardinality is replaced by the upper bound 1 + #neighbours.\n// Seeds with an exact cardinality contribute to exactBest, the others are queued.\n__global__ void roundPrepareKernel(const float2* __restrict__ ptsf,\n                                   const unsigned char* __restrict__ clustered,\n                                   const int* __restrict__ seeds, const int M,\n                                   const long long* __restrict__ off,\n                                   int* __restrict__ nbrCnt, int* __restrict__ nbr,\n                                   int* __restrict__ card, unsigned char* __restrict__ exact,\n                                   const int firstRound, const float2 lastSeed, const float box2,\n                                   unsigned long long* __restrict__ pendKeys,\n                                   int* __restrict__ pendIdx, WorkState* ws) {\n    const int lane = threadIdx.x & (WARP - 1);\n    const unsigned ltMask = (1u << lane) - 1u;\n    const int warpGlobal = (blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x) / WARP;\n    const int numWarps = (gridDim.x * blockDim.x) / WARP;\n    unsigned long long localExact = 0ull;\n    for (int i0 = warpGlobal * WARP; i0 < M; i0 += numWarps * WARP) {\n        // one seed per lane for the cheap checks\n        const int iMine = i0 + lane;\n        int seedMine = 0;\n        bool active = false, touched = false;\n        if (iMine < M) {\n            seedMine = seeds[iMine];\n            active = !clustered[seedMine];\n            if (active) {\n                // Members of the last cluster lie within threshold of its seed, so\n                // only seeds within 2 * threshold (box test, with margin) can change.\n                const float2 pf = ptsf[seedMine];\n                touched = firstRound ||\n                          (fabsf(pf.x - lastSeed.x) <= box2 && fabsf(pf.y - lastSeed.y) <= box2);\n            }\n        }\n        // compact the neighbour lists of touched seeds, one warp-wide pass per seed\n        unsigned todo = __ballot_sync(0xffffffffu, touched);\n        while (todo) {\n            const int src = __ffs(todo) - 1;\n            todo &= todo - 1;\n            const int i = i0 + src;\n            int* list = nbr + off[i];\n            const int K = nbrCnt[i];\n            int w = 0;\n            for (int base = 0; base < K; base += WARP) {\n                const int j = base + lane;\n                bool keep = false;\n                int id = 0;\n                if (j < K) {\n                    id = list[j];\n                    keep = !clustered[id];\n                }\n                const unsigned m = __ballot_sync(0xffffffffu, keep);\n                if (keep) list[w + __popc(m & ltMask)] = id;\n                w += __popc(m);\n            }\n            if (lane == 0 && (firstRound || w != K)) {\n                nbrCnt[i] = w;\n                card[i] = 1 + w;\n                exact[i] = 0;\n            }\n        }\n        __syncwarp();\n        if (active) {\n            const unsigned long long key = packKey(card[iMine], seedMine);\n            if (exact[iMine]) {\n                localExact = key > localExact ? key : localExact;\n            } else {\n                const int slot = atomicAdd(&ws->pending, 1);\n                pendKeys[slot] = key;\n                pendIdx[slot] = iMine;\n            }\n        }\n    }\n    #pragma unroll\n    for (int o = WARP / 2; o > 0; o >>= 1) {\n        const unsigned long long other = __shfl_xor_sync(0xffffffffu, localExact, o);\n        localExact = other > localExact ? other : localExact;\n    }\n    if (lane == 0 && localExact) atomicMax(&ws->exactBest, localExact);\n}\n\n// Evaluate queued seeds in descending order of their upper bound. Exact results update the cache and the best key.\n__global__ void roundEvaluateKernel(const double2* __restrict__ pts,\n                                    const int* __restrict__ seeds,\n                                    const long long* __restrict__ off,\n                                    const int* __restrict__ nbrCnt, const int* __restrict__ nbr,\n                                    int* __restrict__ card, unsigned char* __restrict__ exact,\n                                    const unsigned long long* __restrict__ pendKeys,\n                                    const int* __restrict__ pendIdx, const int count,\n                                    const DistParams dp, Scratch scratch,\n                                    const long long scratchStride, WorkState* ws) {\n    const int lane = threadIdx.x & (WARP - 1);\n    const long long warpGlobal = (blockIdx.x * (long long)blockDim.x + threadIdx.x) / WARP;\n    Scratch s;\n    s.xf = scratch.xf + warpGlobal * scratchStride;\n scratchStride;\n\n    while (true) {\n        int t = 0;\n        unsigned long long cur = 0ull;\n        if (lane == 0) {\n            t = atomicAdd(&ws->counter, 1);\n            cur = *((volatile unsigned long long*)&ws->best);\n        }\n        t = __shfl_sync(0xffffffffu, t, 0);\n        cur = __shfl_sync(0xffffffffu, cur, 0);\n        if (t >= count) break;\n        if (pendKeys[t] <= cur) break;  // sorted: no later seed can win either\n        const int i = pendIdx[t];\n        const int seed = seeds[i];\n        const int c = greedyCluster(seed, nbr + off[i], nbrCnt[i], pts, dp, s, nullptr, &ws->best);\n        if (lane == 0) {\n            if (c > 0) {\n                card[i] = c;\n                exact[i] = 1;\n                atomicMax(&ws->best, packKey(c, seed));\n         const int* __restrict__ nbrCnt, const int* __restrict__ nbr,\n                                     const DistParams dp, Scratch s, int* __restrict__ out,\n There every version and rank count gives the same hash and validation passes. Edge cases also pass: tiny thresholds (all singletons), huge thresholds (one cluster), and more ranks than useful work.\n\n**Speed** (RTX 3090):\n\n| N | Original | New, 1 GPU | New, 4 GPUs |\n|---|---|---|---|\n| 1,000 | 7.0 s | 7 ms | 8 ms |\n| 2,000 | 88.7 s | 12 ms | 12 ms |\n| 3,000 | 479 s | 20 ms | – |\n| 10,000 | – | 103 ms | 85 ms |\n| 50,000 | – | 2.9 s | 1.7 s |\n\nUp to a few thousand points a run takes milliseconds and extra GPUs don't help, because per-round communication costs about as much as the work. The extra GPUs only start to pay off at tens of thousands of points.\n\n**How it works:**\n- **Same algorithm, less repeated work.** A point can only join a seed's cluster if it is within the threshold of that seed, so each seed only looks at its nearby neighbours. Each candidate's distance to the cluster is updated as members are added instead of recomputed. A seed's cluster size is only recalculated when one of its neighbours gets clustered.\n- **Seeds are skipped when they provably can't win.** All members of a cluster fit in a threshold-sized square around the seed, so a seed with fewer points in its best such square can't beat the current best. Seeds are evaluated largest-bound-first. Tie-breaking (largest cluster, then lowest seed index) is unchanged.\n- **CUDA.** Usually one warp builds one candidate cluster; seeds with very large neighbourhoods get a whole thread block using shared memory. The 3090 is slow at double precision, so most checks use single precision with a proven error margin and switch to exact double precision whenever the answer could go either way. Distances use the same fused multiply-add form the original compiled to, which is why results match bit for bit.\n- **MPI.** Seeds are split round-robin across ranks, with one GPU per rank. Each round needs one Allreduce to find the winner and one broadcast of its members from the rank that owns it. A whole round runs as a single pre-recorded CUDA graph.\n- **OpenMP.** Used for host-side preprocessing and validation. Threads are divided among the ranks on a node and started before the timer.\n- **Build.** The source is compiled as CUDA and needs CMake 3.24 or newer. GPU code is built for the GPUs on the build machine (`CMAKE_CUDA_ARCHITECTURES=native`) unless you set it. Without this, CMake defaulted to an old architecture and every first run lost about 1.3 s to recompilation. The only extra library is CUB, which ships with the CUDA toolkit.\n\n**What changed in the timing and output.** The timed region now includes copying the data to the GPU and building the neighbour lists, but not GPU context setup. Only rank 0 prints.\n\n**Small N hangs, as in the original.** For N below about 30 the data generator in the original never finishes, because each generated group always has zero points.
